title: Kozuchi Agent: A Language-Agnostic Open-Weight Agent for Software Repair

evidence.sentence: We report this Pareto as a descriptive cost curve over this run rather than as a prescription; an early-stopping policy that exploits it would need its own controlled study.
Each policy needs its own controlled study before deployment.
We present Kozuchi Agent, a and language-agnostic open-weight repair agent .

We rank our system on a frozen snapshot of 135 publicly cataloged SWE-bench Verified as of April 28, 2026, and run paired McNemar exact tests [26] on the per-instance outcome vectors of a curated set of 17 open-weight and 7 closed-frontier peers.

data_generation_methods.evidence: Early prototypes exposed recurring operational failures: long repair contexts lost evidence and repeated work, model-specific tool syntax made backend swaps brittle, shell-only debugging localized defects poorly, and multi-hour benchmark stages made recomputation expensive.
